resources.string: Allow unencrypted HTTP for this endpoint
HTTP: the passage and optional token travel without encryption. Use only a trusted network.
The endpoint changed. Its old token will not be reused; enter a token for the new address if needed.
API token is optional. Leave it empty for a server without authentication.

Ollama base address, without /api/chat. 127.0.0.1 means this phone, not your computer. For a LAN server, enter its reachable address. The model must already be installed on that server; this app does not download models.

Base address including the API prefix, for example https://host/v1/. The app appends chat/completions. Only non-streaming text Chat Completions is supported; images, tools and Story Guide are not implied.

Choose the route explicitly. Direct mode sends the selected passage to the chosen endpoint, which may be local, on your network or in the cloud. It does not install a model on the phone. No automatic route switching. Saving makes no network or billable request.
Use a model ID from your provider account. Availability and price are not verified by saving. Tokens are encrypted on this device and scoped to this BookOrbit account and server.
Direct Story Guide is not supported yet: structured context and spoiler boundaries are not verified. BookOrbit is not used as a fallback. Select the server route explicitly to use its Story Guide.
Configure the AI connection or reopen this panel after changing it. No fallback request was made.

Send only this selected passage to %1$s using model %2$s at the address below? The endpoint may forward it to a cloud provider and charge your account. No full book, BookOrbit token or account identifiers are sent. The AI can still be wrong or reveal inferred spoilers. No retry or route fallback is automatic.
